/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import app

assert app.text_metrics('a\\tb\\u00a0c\\n') == {'characters': 6, 'words': 3}

wire = '{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"雪🙂 a\\\\tb\"}\\n{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n'.encode()
for split in range(len(wire) + 1):
    p = app.EventStream()
    got = p.feed(wire[:split]) + p.feed(wire[split:])
    expected_text = '雪🙂 a\\tb'
    assert got == [
        {'event': 'token', 'text': expected_text},
        {'event': 'done', 'text': expected_text, 'characters': len(expected_text), 'words': 3},
    ], split
    assert p.state == 'DONE' and p.buffered_bytes == 0
    assert p.finish() == [] and p.finish() == []

p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=16)
assert p.feed(b'{\"event\"') == []
assert p.buffered_bytes == 7
assert p.feed(b':\"done\"}\\n') == [{'event': 'done', 'text': '', 'characters': 0, 'words': 0}]
assert p.buffered_bytes == 0

p = app.EventStream(max_buffer=32)
chunk = b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":\"\"}\\n' * 100 + b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\n'
events = p.feed(chunk)
assert len(events) == 101 and p.state == 'DONE'

for payload in (b'\\n', b'{\"event\":\"token\",\"text\":1}\\n', b'{}\\n'):
    p = app.EventStream()
    try:
        p.feed(payload)
    except app.StreamError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(payload)
    assert p.state == 'FAILED' and p.buffered_bytes == 0
    for op in (lambda: p.feed(b''), p.finish):
        try:
            op()
        except app.StreamError:
            pass
        else:
            raise AssertionError('failed stream was reusable')

p = app.EventStream()
try:
    p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"done\"}\\nX')
except app.StreamError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('trailing data accepted')
assert p.state == 'FAILED' and p.buffered_bytes == 0

p = app.EventStream()
assert p.feed(b'{\"event\":\"error\",\"message\":\"no\"}\\n') == [{'event': 'error', 'message': 'no'}]
assert p.state == 'ERROR' and p.finish() == []
try:
    p.feed(b'x')
except app.StreamError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('post-terminal data accepted')
print('contract checks passed')
PY"
